entities.name: Frankie Negrón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frankie Negrón is a singer of salsa music and songwriter of Puerto Rican descent. He is among a group of notable young tropical singers and soneros who have woven a blend of pop, rock, gospel music, R&B, hip-hop, and reggaetón elements into their salsa, a group that includes Huey Dunbar, Charlie Cruz, and Kevin Ceballo. Siblings include a younger sister, Jaqueline Negrón, who is also a singer and dancer, and a brother, David Negrón.
